title: Power of Appointment
description: A testamentary power granting someone the authority to decide how assets or trust interests are distributed. Common in complex wills — the testator grants discretion to an appointee (typically an executor or trustee) to allocate among a defined class of beneficiaries
$comment: general: appointee can appoint to anyone, including themselves — treated as part of appointee's estate for tax purposes. special: appointee can only appoint among a defined class of beneficiaries. hybrid: a mix — general for some purposes, special for others (e.g. general power exercisable only by will). Powers of appointment are distinct from bequests — a bequest is an immediate gift; a power is discretionary authority to be exercised later

id.description: Unique identifier for this power of appointment

appointorPersonId.description: The person granting the power (usually the testator)

appointorPersonIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the appointor

appointeePersonId.description: The person who holds the power and may exercise it (e.g. executor, trustee, spouse)

appointeePersonIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the appointee

powerType.description: Whether this is a general, special, or hybrid power of appointment

classOfBeneficiaries.description: Natural-language definition of who the appointee may appoint to. Required for special and hybrid powers
examples: Any registered charity in England and Wales
My spouse and children in such shares as the appointee sees fit

scope.description: Which assets, trusts, or bequests this power covers. If absent, the power applies to the entire residuary estate

exerciseConditions.description: Conditions or limitations on how the power may be exercised
examples: Exercisable only with the consent of the protector
Must be exercised within 2 years of the testator's death

exercisedDate.description: Date the power was exercised, if it has been

exercisedDocumentId.description: Reference to the Document.id recording the exercise of this power

notes.description: Free-text notes about this power of appointment
